title: 🔥LA GUÍA DEFINITIVA DE BLENDER! (Curso completo en Español) | Desde cero! 4.5

chapters.title: Modelar la taza y el plato

about: What Lucius kept from this tutorial: one recipe per chapter, each continuing from the scene of the one before. Replay with `lucius teach course courses/lrlpwIumFnE` (no API needed).

lessons.title: Navigating the interface (Interfaz)
lessons.note: Learned by the Gemini lesson loop: default scene, a subdivided and transformed cube, primitives, edit-mode selections, ending with the circle the mug starts from.

lessons.title: Modelar la taza y el plato
lessons.note: Mug from the circle: extrude, inset, hollow, rim and base bevels, loop cuts, handle bridged between two face patches, subsurf. Plate: circle filled, insets for the dish and rim, underside extruded, foot.

lessons.title: Modelar donut y croissant
lessons.note: Croissant: circle profile mirrored, extruded in grooved segments along a curve, tips closed; donut: torus with cloud displacement; a second donut duplicated and tilted.

lessons.title: Sistema de partículas
lessons.note: Sugar crystal scattered over both donuts with a hair particle system; everything placed as in the tutor's composition.

lessons.title: Materiales
lessons.note: Porcelain, donut dough (subsurface), glassy sugar, croissant, tablecloth with a brick pattern and a fabric bump.

lessons.title: Iluminación
lessons.note: Spot from the front-top gives the pool of light on the plate, warm point light behind as rim, black world.

lessons.title: Cámara
lessons.note: Camera front/above; scene scaled x0.05 to real size; lights lowered to keep the look; depth of field on the donut at f/1; square 1080.

lessons.title: Renderizado
lessons.note: Final Cycles render: key area panel front-left at 4500 K, rim light raised, bigger sugar, glossier croissant, blue cloth with small white squares turned on Z, f/2.8, Standard view.
